settings.content: # GMM Usage Dashboard ## Summary Use this dashboard to view live metrics and analyze usage of GMM across your tenant.

content.Query:
customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| order by timestamp desc
| project timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
    DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"])
| where Result == "Success" and DryRun == false
| distinct Destination
| summarize Count = count()

customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| order by timestamp desc
| project timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
    DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"]),
    SourceTypesCounts = tostring(customDimensions["SourceTypesCounts"])
| where Result == "Success" and DryRun == false
| extend Message = replace("{|}", "", SourceTypesCounts) // Remove curly braces
| extend Message = split(Message, ",") // Split by comma to create an array
| mv-expand Message
| extend SourceType = tostring(split(Message, ":")[0]) // Extract the type
| extend Count = toint(trim(" ", tostring(split(Message, ":")[1]))) // Extract the count and convert to int
| order by Destination, timestamp
| where Destination != prev(Destination) and Destination != ''
| summarize Count = sum(Count) by SourceType // Sum the counts for each type
| project SourceType, Count // Project the type and total count

[format('let gmm_logs = union
  (ApplicationLog_CL | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s, Destination_s, TargetOfficeGroupId_g),
  (AppTraces | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s=tostring(Properties.Location), Destination_s=tostring(Properties.Destination), TargetOfficeGroupId_g=tostring(Properties.TargetOfficeGroupId));
gmm_logs
 | where location_s == "JobTrigger" and Message startswith "Linked services:" 
 | join kind = inner ( 
    app("{0}").customEvents 
    | where name == "SyncComplete" 
    | project timestamp,
        Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
        Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
        DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"])
    | where Result == "Success" and DryRun == false
    | distinct Destination
)
on $left.Destination_s == $right.Destination
| project TimeGenerated, Destination_s, TargetOfficeGroupId_g, Services = split(tostring(extract("services:(.*)", 1, Message)),",") 
| mv-expand Service = Services 
| distinct Destination_s, tostring(Service) 
| summarize Groups=count() by tostring(Service) 
 | order by Groups

', parameters('resourceGroup'))]

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| order by timestamp desc
| project
    timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
    DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"]),
    Lane = customDimensions["Identifier"]
| where Result == "Success" and DryRun == false and Lane == "onboarding"
| distinct Destination
| summarize Count = count()

content.Query:
customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| project
    timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
    DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"]),
    Lane = tostring(customDimensions["Identifier"])
| where Result == "Success" and DryRun == false and Lane in ("small", "large")
| summarize SyncCount = dcount(Destination) by Lane
| project
    LaneSize = case(Lane == "small", "Small",
                     Lane == "large", "Large",
                     "Other"),
    SyncCount
| order by LaneSize

let migrationStart = toscalar(
    customMetrics
    | where name == "SyncComplete"
    | summarize min(timestamp)
);
union
(
    customMetrics
    | where name == "SyncComplete"
    | extend Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"])
    | where Result in ("Success", "PartialSuccess")
    | extend customMetric_valueSum = iif(itemType == 'customMetric', valueSum, todouble(''))
),
(
    customEvents
    | where name == "SyncComplete"
    | where isnull(migrationStart) or timestamp < migrationStart
    | extend Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"])
    | extend DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"])
    | where Result in ("Success", "PartialSuccess") and DryRun == false
    | extend customMetric_valueSum = todouble(1)
)
| extend ResultLabel = case(Result == "Success", "Success Jobs", "Partial Success Jobs")
| summarize ['customMetrics/SyncComplete_sum'] = sum(customMetric_valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), ResultLabel

customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| order by timestamp desc
| project timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Type = tostring(customDimensions["Type"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
    DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"]),
    Onboarding = tobool(customDimensions["IsInitialSync"])
| where Result == "Success" and DryRun == false and Onboarding == true
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1d), Type

customEvents
| where name == "NumberOfJobsStarted"

| distinct RunId

customEvents

    Status = tostring(customDimensions["Status"]),

| where ResultStatus == "Success" or ResultStatus == "Failure"

| summarize Count = count()

customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| order by timestamp desc
| project timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),

customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| order by timestamp desc
| project timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
    DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"]),
    ToAdd = toint(customDimensions["MembersAdded"]),
    ToRemove = toint(customDimensions["MembersRemoved"])
| where Result == "Success" and DryRun == false and Destination != ''
| extend DestinationType = tostring(parse_json(Destination)[0].type)
| summarize UsersAdded = sum(ToAdd) by bin(timestamp, 1d), DestinationType

customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| order by timestamp desc
| project timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
    DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"]),
    ToAdd = toint(customDimensions["MembersAdded"]),

customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| project MembersAdded = toint(customDimensions["MembersAdded"]),
    MembersRemoved = toint(customDimensions["MembersRemoved"]),
    Destination = toguid(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Result = customDimensions["Result"],
    DryRun = customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"],
    RunId = toguid(customDimensions["RunId"])
| where Result == "Success" and DryRun == "False"
| distinct RunId, MembersAdded, MembersRemoved
| summarize NoOps = countif(MembersAdded == 0 and MembersRemoved == 0), Total = count()
| extend NoOpsPercent = todouble(NoOps) / Total * 100

let P1 = toscalar(
    customEvents
	| where name == "IdleJobsTracker"
	| order by timestamp desc
	| project timestamp,
			  Id = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
			  Frequency = toint(customDimensions["Frequency"]),
			  JobStarted = toint(customDimensions["JobStarted"])
	| summarize StartReliabilityPercentage = (toreal(countif(JobStarted >= 1)) / sum(Frequency)) * 100
);
let P2 = toscalar(
    customEvents
	| where name == "InProgressJobsTracker"
	| order by timestamp desc
	| project timestamp,
		Id = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
		Frequency = toint(customDimensions["Frequency"]),
		RunId = toguid(customDimensions["RunId"])
	| where Frequency > 0
	| summarize max(Frequency) by RunId
	| join kind=rightouter (
		customEvents
		| where name == "NumberOfJobsStarted"
		| order by timestamp desc
		| project timestamp,
			JobStartedRunId = toguid(customDimensions["RunId"])
		| distinct JobStartedRunId)
		on $left.RunId == $right.JobStartedRunId
	| summarize
		CountOfJobsThatDidNotGoOverPeriod = (toreal(countif(isnull(RunId)))),
		CountOfAllExpectedJobs =  (countif(JobStartedRunId != "") + sum(max_Frequency) - countif(max_Frequency > 0))
	| project InProgressReliabilityPercentage = CountOfJobsThatDidNotGoOverPeriod / CountOfAllExpectedJobs * 100
);
print ReliabilityPercentage = (P1 + P2) / 2

content.Query:
let migrationStart = toscalar(
    customMetrics
    | where name == "ResourceUnitsUsed" and isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["QueryType"]))
    | summarize min(timestamp)
);
union
(
    customMetrics
    | where name == "ResourceUnitsUsed"
    | extend QueryType = tostring(customDimensions["QueryType"])
    | where isnotempty(QueryType)
    | extend customMetric_valueSum = iif(itemType == 'customMetric', valueSum, todouble(''))
),
(
    customEvents
    | where name == "ResourceUnitsUsedByType"
    | where isnull(migrationStart) or timestamp < migrationStart
    | extend QueryType = tostring(customDimensions["QueryType"])
    | extend customMetric_valueSum = todouble(toint(customDimensions["ResourceUnitsUsed"]))
)
| summarize ['customMetrics/ResourceUnitsUsed_sum'] = sum(customMetric_valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 10s), QueryType

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
let gmm_logs = union
  (ApplicationLog_CL | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s),
  (AppTraces | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s=tostring(Properties.Location));
gmm_logs
| where Message contains "OrchestratorFunction number of jobs" and location_s == "JobTrigger"
| extend JobCount = toint(extract("number of jobs in the syncJobs List: (\\d+)", 1, Message))
| project timestamp = TimeGenerated, JobCount

settings.content: # Troubleshooting Dashboard ## Summary Use this dashboard to view any potential issues that may be occurring in GMM now or within the past X number of days.

content.Query:
customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| order by timestamp desc
| project timestamp,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    Type = tostring(customDimensions["Type"]),
    Result = tostring(customDimensions["Result"]),
    DryRun = tobool(customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"])
| where (Result == "PartialSuccess" or Result == "Failure") and DryRun == false
| summarize by Destination, Result, Bin = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| summarize count() by Bin, Result

let gmm_logs = union
  (ApplicationLog_CL | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s, RunId_g),
  (AppTraces | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s=tostring(Properties.Location), RunId_g=tostring(Properties.RunId));
gmm_logs
| where isnotempty(location_s)
| where ((location_s != "ProfileSync") and (Message has "exception" or Message has "error") and Message !has "Response" and Message !has "ErrorInvalidRecipients" and Message !has "Regex Expression:") or (Message has "Setting job status to" and Message !has "Idle" and Message !has "InProgress" and Message !has "StuckInProgress")
| where Message !startswith "Dispatched job status"
| distinct TimeGenerated, location_s, Message, RunId_g
| order by TimeGenerated desc

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
let gmm_logs = union
  (ApplicationLog_CL | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s, RunId_g, TargetOfficeGroupId_g),
  (AppTraces | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s=tostring(Properties.Location), RunId_g=tostring(Properties.RunId), TargetOfficeGroupId_g=tostring(Properties.TargetOfficeGroupId));
gmm_logs
|  project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s, RunId_g, TargetOfficeGroupId_g 
|  where location_s in ("JobTrigger", "GraphUpdater") and not(Message has_any("Email", "FilePath")) and Message has "RunId" 
|  order by RunId_g desc, TimeGenerated asc 
|  where location_s == "JobTrigger" and RunId_g == next(RunId_g) and next(location_s) <> "GraphUpdater" 
|  project TimeGenerated, TargetOfficeGroupId_g, RunId_g 
|  where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and TimeGenerated < ago(1d) and TargetOfficeGroupId_g  != RunId_g 
|  order by TimeGenerated desc

content.Query:
let gmm_logs = union
  (ApplicationLog_CL | project TimeGenerated, Message, RunId_g, Destination_s=tostring(Destination_s)),
  (AppTraces | project TimeGenerated, Message, RunId_g=tostring(Properties.RunId), Destination_s=tostring(Properties.Destination));
gmm_logs
|  project TimeGenerated, Message, RunId_g, Destination_s
|  where Message has 'setting status to ErroredDueToStuckInProgress'
|  where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and TimeGenerated < ago(1d)
|  extend DestinationJson = parse_json(Destination_s)
|  project TimeGenerated,
           ObjectId = tostring(DestinationJson[0]["value"]["objectId"]),
           ChannelId = tostring(DestinationJson[0]["value"]["channelId"]),
           RunId_g
|  order by TimeGenerated desc

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:

  (ApplicationLog_CL | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s, RunId_g, TargetOfficeGroupId_g),
  (AppTraces | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s=tostring(Properties.Location), RunId_g=tostring(Properties.RunId), TargetOfficeGroupId_g=tostring(Properties.TargetOfficeGroupId));
gmm_logs

| where Message has "Threshold Exceeded"

content.Query:
let gmm_logs = union
  (ApplicationLog_CL | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s, RunId_g, Destination_s),
  (AppTraces | project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s=tostring(Properties.Location), RunId_g=tostring(Properties.RunId), Destination_s=tostring(Properties.Destination));
gmm_logs
| project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s, RunId_g, Destination_s
| where Message has "Threshold Exceeded"
| extend DestinationJson = parse_json(Destination_s)
| project TimeGenerated, Message, location_s, RunId_g,
            ObjectId = tostring(DestinationJson[0]["value"]["objectId"]),
            ChannelId = tostring(DestinationJson[0]["value"]["channelId"])
| distinct ObjectId, ChannelId, RunId_g, TimeGenerated
| order by TimeGenerated desc

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
customMetrics
| where name == "SyncJobTimeElapsedSeconds"
| project Seconds = todouble(value) * 1s
| summarize Count = count() by DurationBin = bin(Seconds + 1m, 1m)
| order by DurationBin desc
| project DurationBin = tostring(DurationBin), Jobs = toint(Count)

content.Query:
customEvents
| where name == "SyncComplete"
| project TimeElapsed = todouble(customDimensions["SyncJobTimeElapsedSeconds"]) * 1s,
    Destination = tostring(customDimensions["Destination"]),
    RunId = customDimensions["RunId"],
    Result = customDimensions["Result"],
    DryRun = customDimensions["IsDryRunEnabled"]
| where Result == "Success" and DryRun == "False"
| extend DestinationJson = parse_json(Destination)
| project TimeElapsed,
          ObjectId = tostring(DestinationJson[0]["value"]["objectId"]),
          ChannelId = tostring(DestinationJson[0]["value"]["channelId"]), 
          RunId
| order by TimeElapsed desc

customEvents
| where name == "TrackNullColumns"
| project timestamp,    
    Column = tostring(customDimensions["Column"]),
    CurrentNulls = toint(customDimensions["CurrentNull"]),
    PreviousNulls = toint(customDimensions["PreviousNull"]),
    CurrentRows = toint(customDimensions["CurrentRows"]),
    PreviousRows = toint(customDimensions["PreviousRows"])
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by Column
| extend Delta = CurrentNulls - PreviousNulls,
         CurrentNullPercent = (toreal(CurrentNulls) / CurrentRows) * 100,
         PreviousNullPercent = (toreal(PreviousNulls) / PreviousRows) * 100
| project timestamp, Column, CurrentNulls, PreviousNulls, Delta, CurrentNullPercent, PreviousNullPercent
| order by Delta desc
